simple.meaning: חֹר הַגִּדְגָּד (Chôr hag-Gidgâd) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chor-hag-Gidgad , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֹר הַגִּדְגָּד (H2735) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 33:32, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹר הַגִּדְגָּד (H2735) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֹר הַגִּדְגָּד (H2735) before moving outward to related references.
